A string in the license expression format.

A Package that contains AI software or an AI model.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where all elements apply.
Specifies the exploit catalog type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: low
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 0.1 - 3.9.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: x509Cert
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an X.509 certificate as defined in [RFC 5280](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc5280/). The primary media type shall be `application/pkix-cert`. The legacy media types `application/x-x509-ca-cert` and `application/x-x509-user-cert` may be used for backward compatibility, but shall not be used in new implementations. NOTE — RFC 5280 supersedes earlier X.509 profiles, including RFC 1422. Existing references based on RFC 1422 remain valid.
A license or a license addition that is not listed on the SPDX License List.
Class that describes a process.
Describes a sensor used for collecting the data.
A collection of SPDX Elements that could potentially be serialized.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: text
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists of unstructured text, such as a book, a Wikipedia article (without images), or a transcript.
This is the agent that performed the act of destroying the item.
Protocols which support authentication.
Information related to physical hardware.
Identifies the full text of a LicenseAddition, in SPDX templating format.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: delegatedTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Agent is delegating an action to the Agent of the `to` Relationship (which shall be of type invokedBy), during a LifecycleScopeType period (e.g. the `to` invokedBy Relationship is being done on behalf of `from`).
AssemblyAction represents the event of creating a product by assembling individual components.
A license that is listed on the SPDX License List.
Defines the beginning of a range.
An SPDX Element containing an SPDX license expression string.
References the Element on the left-hand side of a relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: install
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is used to install software on disk.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: binaryArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to binary artifacts related to a package.
Additional relevance information.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: security
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Security profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conditionalAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 3 - Conditional automation. The system can propose strategies and then automatically execute the approved plan, with an external agent being ready to take over when necessary.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDependencyManifest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has manifest files that contain dependency information in each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isci
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: International Standard Collection Identifier (ISCI) is a variable-length identifier standardized by [ISO 27730](https://www.iso.org/standard/44293.html) for identifying collections held by libraries, archives, museums, and other memory institutions. It consists of two parts: the identifier for the assigning organization (an ISIL) enclosed in square brackets, followed by a local collection identifier string (e.g., `[FR-751041001]Casadesus1`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lite
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Lite profile specification.
An assumptionUID is a unique identifier assigned to an Assumption item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: framework
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software framework.
A physical location is a tangible, geographically identifiable place where objects, people, or assets exist or operate.
A substitute for a URI.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidenceUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier used by a reporting management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify an evidence relationship item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through instrumenting the system running the software, to capture only components present in the system, as well as external call-outs or dynamically loaded components. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as an "Instrumented" or "Dynamic" SBOM.
Describes a relationship between one or more elements.
Use Process defines actions used by elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: software
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Software profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data type is not known.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe23
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Platform Enumeration: Naming Specification Version 2.3](https://csrc.nist.gov/publications/detail/nistir/7695/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: falcon
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [FALCON](https://falcon-sign.info/falcon.pdf)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: custody
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Custody refers to the responsibility, control, and safekeeping of an asset, person, or legal entity. It involves both physical possession and legal authority over something or someone.
Assessment of an Element for export control classification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isil
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Identifier for Libraries and Related Organizations (ISIL)](https://slks.dk/english/work-areas/libraries-and-literature/library-standards/isil/) is a unique alphanumeric code for identifying libraries, archives, museums, and related organizations standardized by [ISO 15511](https://www.iso.org/standard/77849.html). It consists of a prefix—which may be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or a non-country code assigned by the ISIL Registration Authority—followed by a unit identifier, totaling up to 16 characters (e.g., `FI-Sipoo-Sö` or `ZDB-1-SBD`). Valid symbols include any alphanumeric character, solidus (`/`), hyphen-minus (`-`), or colon.
A class for describing the energy consumption incurred by an AI model in different stages of its lifecycle.
How the dataset was collected.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: any hashing algorithm that does not exist in this list of entries

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cve
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures identifiers, an identifier for a specific software flaw defined within the official CVE Dictionary and that conforms to the [CVE specification](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/cve_id).
A product specification (product spec) is a detailed document that outlines the technical, functional, and design requirements of a product.
A requirementUID is a unique identifier assigned to a Requirement.
A license exception that is listed on the SPDX Exceptions list.
A key with an Element.
The valid state for DefinedStateProcess.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Provides an independently reproducible mechanism that permits verification of a specific Element.

EvidenceRelationship defines the association between pieces of evidence and EvaluationResult.
An actual change to a product's location.
A key used in a generic key-value pair.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md4
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD4 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1186](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1186/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: service
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Service profile specification.
Information related to hardware dimension.
Timestamp of impact statement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: platform
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element represents a runtime environment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pretrainedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been pretrained on the `to` Element(s).
Dimensions generally refer to measurable extents or attributes that define the size, shape, or scale of an object, system, or concept.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is of a type not included in this list.
A specification is a detailed description of the design, requirements, or features of a product, process, or system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: metrics
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to metrics related to a package such as OpenSSF scorecards.
Impact justification label to be used when linking a vulnerability to an element representing a VEX product with a VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship relationship.
Location is used to define the location, address or coordinates of a place.
The point in time when an element or an action ends, becomes no longer applicable, or becomes no longer valid.
A distinct article or unit within the domain.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDocumentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is documented by each `to` Element.
A type of extension consisting of a list of name value pairs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake3
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [BLAKE3](https://github.com/BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3-specs/blob/master/blake3.pdf)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ownership
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Ownership refers to the legal right to control, manage, and benefit from an asset, resource, or responsibility. It establishes authority, accountability, and entitlements over something, whether it's property, a business, intellectual property, or responsibilities.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hardware
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Hardware profile specification.
A mathematically calculated representation of a grouping of data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Legislation Identifier (ELI)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/content/help/eurlex-content/eli.html) is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) that uniquely identifies a legal resource, typically consisting of a document type, adoption year, and document number (e.g., `http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/2847/oj`).
Specifies an Element as subject of an assessment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during the execution phase of an element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swhid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits, and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/swhid-specification/v1.2/) ([ISO/IEC 18670](https://www.iso.org/standard/89985.html)). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.
ResponsibilityChangeAction refers to the transfer of responsibility from one party to another.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: video
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is video based, such as a collection of movie clips.
Enumeration of verification types.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inlineMitigationsAlreadyExist
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Built-in inline controls or mitigations prevent an adversary from leveraging the vulnerability.
A prescribed change to a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssessmentFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Relates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability and each `to` Element with a security assessment. The use of the `hasAssessmentFor` type is constrained to `/Security/VulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.
CreationAction represents an event of product creation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: complete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known to be exhaustive.
Records the biases that the dataset is known to encompass.
Availability of dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasInput
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Build/Build, DefinedProcess or Action element has each `to` Element as an input.
Abstract class representing a License or an OrLaterOperator.
Identifies the nature of the contactPointRelationship.
A software agent.
A buildId is a locally unique identifier used by a builder to identify a unique instance of a build produced by it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inconclusive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inconclusive refers to a result or outcome from a verification, test, or analysis that cannot be clearly classified as either positive (successful, pass) or negative (failed, reject). An inconclusive result means there was not enough clear evidence, data, or signal to make a definitive determination, and further investigation or additional testing is necessary. An inconclusive result always shall need a comment on it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element expands out as an artifact described by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Security/VulnAssessmentRelationship is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A test action is a specific action associated with a test.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: staticAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a static analysis report for a package.
Verification preconditions are initial criteria that are to be met prior to initiating the verification method.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: documentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the documentation for a package.
Specifies the type of responsibility held over an asset, property, or entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDistributionArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is distributed as an artifact in each `to` Element (e.g. an RPM or archive file).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Business Identifier Code (BIC), also known as SWIFT-BIC or SWIFT code, is a unique 8 or 11-character alphanumeric code standardized by [ISO 9362](https://www.iso.org/standard/84108.html) to identify financial and non-financial institutions (e.g., `BBWCUS33`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: describes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element describes each `to` Element. To denote the root(s) of a tree of elements in a collection, the rootElement property shall be used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: riskAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a risk assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: extension
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Extension profile specification.
Specifies the licenseId that is preferred to be used in place of a deprecated License or LicenseAddition.
A contact point from an Artifact to an Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 256, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: configuration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is configuration data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Conducting controlled tests, experiments or simulations to verify that specific requirements regarding performance, functionality, robustness, etc. are met.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha224
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 224, as defined in [RFC 3874](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3874/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: limitedSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and there is limited support available from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.
The result of applying a hash algorithm to an Element.
Property describing the session in which a build is invoked.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inspection
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A thorough examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence. An inspection needs to have a defined set of acceptance criteria (e.g. a checklist), a documentation of roles involved in the inspection (e.g. to document the inspector's independence) and a clear documentation of when and how it was performed.
Specifies whether a license or additional text identifier has been marked as deprecated.
Class that describes a build instance of software/artifacts.
Provides additional purpose information of the software artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assumes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element assumes each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption.
Describes the specific responsibility of a Role.
The AssemblyProcess represents the process of creating a product by assembling a set of components, potentially in a way that allows for at disassembly (at least partially).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: tracedToDetail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement is refined and further elaborated by each `to` Requirement, which contains more detailed implementation information.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedIn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A `from` /Security/Vulnerability has been fixed in each `to` Element. The use of the `fixedIn` type is constrained to `/Security/VexFixedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analyzed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through analysis of artifacts (e.g., executables, packages, containers, and virtual machine images) after its build. Such analysis generally requires a variety of heuristics. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as a "3rd party" SBOM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iscc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Content Code (ISCC)](https://iscc.io/) is a content-derived identifier standardized by [ISO 24138](https://www.iso.org/standard/77899.html) for identifying digital assets. ISCC can be used in conjunction with other schemes, such as DOI, ISAN, ISBN, ISRC, ISSN and ISWC. A standard ISCC-CODE is build from multiple ISCC-UNITs. Each unit serve a different purpose. An ISCC-CODE typically look like `ISCC:KACT4EBWK27737D2AYCJRAL5Z36G76RFRMO4554RU26HZ4ORJGIVHDI`.
The action of product use.
Information related to massOfHardware physical hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: secureSoftwareAttestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to information assuring that the software is developed using security practices as defined by [NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/final) or [CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Form](https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/secure-software-development-attestation-form).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: firmware
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element provides low level control over a device's hardware.
EvaluationResult is the result of an evaluation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ancestorOf
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is an ancestor of each `to` Element.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/isoAutomationLevel](../../Core/Properties/isoAutomationLevel.md) instead.
Indicates whether the system can perform a decision or action without human involvement or guidance.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement that has verification (test, review, analysis etc.) details defined in the `to` /FunctionalSafety/RequirementVerification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM of intended, planned software project or product with included components (some of which may not yet exist) for a new software artifact.
A name used in a CdxPropertyEntry name-value pair.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasTestCase
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a test case for the `from` Element (`from` hasTestCase `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audit
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An examination typically focusing on compliance with policies, standards, or regulations. Usually this is done during an audit meeting, while the assessment also involves deep and detailed reviews of work products (e.g. requirements, verification specifications, reports etc.)
Agent represents anything with the potential to act on a system.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A Role defines a specific position, function, or capacity that an entity may assume within any relevant context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: function
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Simulation the function of the hardware.
Identifies the full text of a LicenseAddition.
A distinct unit representing a requirement, as used in systems, software, and hardware engineering.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: attend
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, and may involve publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. CISA recommends remediating Attend vulnerabilities sooner than standard update timelines.
The version of the SPDX License List used in the license expression.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a plan, guideline or strategy how to create, perform or analyze an application.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: partialAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 2 - Partial automation or task automation. Some sub-functions of the system are fully automated while the system remain under control of an external agent. The system can perform actions for an approved task without requiring the agent's continuous direct control.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md5
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD5 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1321](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1321/).
Information related to hardware dimension.
The amount or measure of a bulk product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: resolved
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` /SupplyChain/OutOfSpecAction is resolved in the `from` /SupplyChain/ResolutionAction.
This is the state of an affected Element at a specific moment in time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: foundBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was originally discovered by the `to` Agent(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: patchedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a patch for the `from` Element (`from` patchedBy `to`).
Class that describes an action that has occurred.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: graph
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is in the form of a graph where entries are somehow related to each other through edges, such as a social network of friends.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ai
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the AI profile specification.
The class that helps note down the quantity of energy consumption and the unit used for measurement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: follows
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` Element succeeds the `from` Element, establishing a unidirectional sequence. This succession is defined as chronological, procedural, or logical. It is used to represent either a temporal order (e.g., in a workflow) or a logical order for processing and traversal (e.g., in an ordered list).
Specifies the time an artifact was released.
A concrete subclass of AnyLicenseInfo used by Individuals in the ExpandedLicensing profile.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerabilityExploitabilityAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX) statement which provides information on whether a product is impacted by a specific vulnerability in an included package and, if affected, whether there are actions recommended to remediate. See also [NTIA VEX one-page summary](https://ntia.gov/files/ntia/publications/vex_one-page_summary.pdf).
The category describes the hardware item in a DefinedType.
An assertion made in relation to one or more elements.
Date of product release.
Quantity is the amount in the selected QUDT unit.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: formalStandard
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A formal standard is a standard ratified by a recognized standards-development organization and published as a normative reference.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where only one of the elements applies.
RoleRelationship represents a relationship between an entity holding a role and the scope or context in which that role applies. The givenRole property specifies the role assigned.
This is the planned product associated with the change of responsibility.
An inspection action refers to a specific activity or set of activities performed during an inspection to examine, verify, or evaluate an item, process, or system.
A characterization of some aspect of an Element that is associated with the Element in a generalized fashion.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: autonomous
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 6 - Autonomous. The system is capable of modifying its intended domain of use or its goals without external intervention, control or oversight.
A distinct article or unit related to Software.
Reproduction is the biological process by which living organisms produce offspring.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eori
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) number](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/customs/customs-procedures-import-and-export/customs-operations/economic-operators-registration-and-identification-number-eori_en) is a unique identifier for businesses undertaking customs operations across European Union customs territory, such as import, export, and transit. It consists of an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code followed by a national identifier of up to 15 alphanumeric characters (e.g., `PL1234567890ABCDE`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: act
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level and leadership-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, as well as publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. Typically, internal groups would meet to determine the overall response and then execute agreed upon actions. CISA recommends remediating Act vulnerabilities as soon as possible.
A short description of an Element.
Base domain class from which all other SPDX 3 domain classes derive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Natural Location Identifier (NLI)](https://eccma.org/enli-eccma-natural-location-identifier/) is a 14- or 15-character alphanumeric string standardized by [ISO 8000-118](https://www.iso.org/standard/85428.html) that uniquely identifies a three-dimensional geographic point location. The identifier is generated from geodetic coordinates and elevation data. For electronic storage, the `ISO.NLI:` prefix shall be retained (e.g., `ISO.NLI:41TS8M-A8ELTQ-H2`).
Identifies the tooling that was used during the creation of the Element.
Provides information about the content type of an Element or a property.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: track
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability does not require action at this time. The organization would continue to track the vulnerability and reassess it if new information becomes available. CISA recommends remediating Track vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: compliance
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point for compliance (i.e. export control, licensing).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: productMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional product metadata such as a reference within an organization's product catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funding
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to funding information related to a package.
A canonical, unique, immutable identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasHost
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Build/Build was run on the `to` Element during a LifecycleScopeType period (e.g. the host that the build runs on).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: supplyChain
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the SupplyChain profile specification.
A license that is not listed on the SPDX License List.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: backlog
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement has been captured and logged, but not yet ready to become a formal requirement draft. A backlog requirement may still be incomplete or ambiguous.
Information about the relationship between two Elements.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing this version, or any later version, of the indicated License.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gitoid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Gitoid](https://www.iana.org/assignments/uri-schemes/prov/gitoid), stands for [Git Object ID](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Internals-Git-Objects). A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).
